_comment: amazon-cloudwatch-agent config (logs-only). Tails the clean per-tick status file that run_tick.py writes (deploy/quiver.service sets QUIVER_TICK_LOG=/var/log/quiver/tick.log) and ships each line to the /quiver/tick log group, where the Terraform metric-filter alarms (AUTH_ERROR / write_kill / plan error) fire to SNS. Installed + started by deploy/setup.sh. No metrics section on purpose: logs-only keeps the instance-role IAM minimal (the role already grants logs:Create*/PutLogEvents/DescribeLogStreams). The /quiver/tick group + its 30-day retention are owned by Terraform; this config only writes into it.
